name: Aeon Stone (Western Star)
text:
This blue crystal is cut in the shape of a five-pointed star. A western star aeon stone must be activated to provide a benefit. The resonant power grants you a +1 item bonus to Deception checks.

Activate—Illusory Disguise 2 (concentrate, illusion, manipulate, visual)

Frequency once per day

---
Effect The western star aeon stone casts a 1st-rank Illusory Disguise to your specifications. If you so choose, the disguise obscures any aeon stones orbiting your head, rendering them invisible until the activation ends.
